name: Conciergerie express
pitch: Free yourself from those little chores! With Conciergerie express, your dry cleaning, shoe repairs, parcels and small errands are taken care of at home or at the office. Book a slot in two clicks in the app: a courier picks everything up and brings it back for you. For €19 a month, four visits included (€6 per extra visit). Available in Paris and the inner suburbs.
targetAudience: Professionals aged 25 to 35 in the Paris region, with no time for small chores.
businessModel: Monthly subscription at €19 (4 visits included), extra visits at €6.
alternatives: Parcel pickup points near the office

target.eligibility: age >= 25 and age <= 35 and region == IDF and pcs == 3 and activity_status == employed
